name: Auto LLMS (.txt) Generator
author: Abesh Das

sections.description:
Auto LLMS (.txt) Generator is a WordPress plugin that dynamically creates llms.txt and llms-full.txt files. It lists pages, WooCommerce products, blog posts, and product categories, pulling meta descriptions for SEO optimization and dynamically fetching Yoast SEO sitemap URLs. It filters out entries with empty meta descriptions and removes shortcodes and placeholder tags from the output.

Key Features:
* Generates llms.txt and llms-full.txt files on demand
* Includes WooCommerce products and categories dynamically
* Filters out content with empty meta descriptions
* Fetches live Yoast SEO sitemap URLs
* Cleans output by removing shortcodes and placeholders
sections.installation:
1. Upload the auto-llms-generator folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Flush rewrite rules by going to Settings > Permalinks and clicking ‘Save Changes’ or by deactivating/reactivating the plugin.
  4. Access the generated llms.txt file at https://yourdomain.com/llms.txt and https://yourdomain.com/llms-full.txt.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin support WooCommerce products?

Yes, it dynamically includes WooCommerce products and categories in the generated files.

How do I access the generated llms.txt?

Simply visit https://yourdomain.com/llms.txt and https://yourdomain.com/llms-full.txt after plugin activation and flushing rewrite rules.

Can I customize output formatting?

Currently, customization requires modifying plugin code.
